[TEST-TRAVEL-001: INTERNATIONAL APPROVAL]
Employees must obtain written approval from their division head before booking international business travel.

[TEST-TRAVEL-002: BOOKING]
All flights and hotels must be booked through the approved corporate travel provider unless the service is unavailable during an emergency.

[TEST-TRAVEL-003: EXPENSE DEADLINE]
Out-of-pocket travel expenses must be submitted within 30 calendar days after the traveler returns.

[TEST-TRAVEL-004: HOTEL AND RECEIPTS]
Hotel claims require an itemized receipt. Personal entertainment and minibar charges are not reimbursable.

[TEST-TRAVEL-005: GROUND TRANSPORT]
Public transport should be used when safe and practical. Taxis may be claimed when public transport is unavailable or creates a documented safety concern.
